name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2494: a cold review predicted how one_name decays - someone adds a consumer and hard-codes another variant while the originals keep being patched. That has already happened five times here and two of those maps were written in one day by the same hand fixing the others. The census of resolver-shaped declarations is now a ratchet: 8 today, scanned by shape rather than name because a name is how these get missed, and it may only fall. It also fails if the baseline goes stale or if one_name disappears.
